description: March 12 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 3, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 12 birthday falls in Pisces, in the third decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: March 12 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: March 12 reduces to 3, giving voice to the Pluto-sub-ruled third decan of Pisces. The Sun is around twenty-one degrees into the sign. Expression here is rarely light: traditionally it points to someone who writes, sings or talks about the hidden currents of life, and who can make difficult emotions easier for others to name.

On March 12 the Sun usually sits at about 21° Pisces, in the third decan, where Pluto is the sub-ruler alongside Neptune. Pluto, modern ruler of Scorpio, governs the last ten degrees of Pisces, which cover roughly March 11 to March 20. At the very end of the zodiac, the sign's empathy gains depth, focus and a capacity for transformation. Those born here are often described as perceptive, private and drawn to the hidden side of life, whether psychology, mystery or spiritual work. Feelings run strong and sometimes stay unspoken. Pluto adds resilience and a talent for helping others through change. When this decan trusts its intensity rather than hiding it, sensitivity tends to become a genuine strength.

sections.heading: March 12 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 12th reduces as 1 + 2 = 3, so the birthday number is 3, but the compound holds two stories at once. The 1 brings self-direction and the 2 brings cooperation, and together they produce the 3's expressive, sociable energy. Twelfth-of-the-month natives are often described as communicators who can lead a conversation and also make space for others in it. As with every day number, this is a secondary influence beside the Life Path. Its particular gift tends to be creative work that depends on teamwork, where one voice sets the tone and many voices fill it out.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one March 12 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on March 12: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 12 is the 71st day of the year (72nd in a leap year). By March 21, 9 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aries.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 12, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on March 12 include Gabriele D'Annunzio (1863), Mitt Romney (1947) and Liza Minnelli (1946).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 12?
faq.answer: March 12 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 12?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 12 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 12th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 12?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 12 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 12?
faq.answer: March 12 is also the birthday of Gabriele D'Annunzio (1863), Mitt Romney (1947) and Liza Minnelli (1946). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
